name: sheet05_candidate_regions
description: Pixel-space regions of Sanborn Galveston 1912 Sheet 5 (sanborn08539_004_img009_archival.jp2, 6653x7795). Coordinate system: full-resolution source pixels, x right, y down. Independent review finding (Fable review workspace). Scale on plate: 100 ft = ~309 px. Page orientation: page-left = north (Galveston Bay), page-down = west (increasing numbered streets), per compass rose at (3990,5180).

properties.description: East panel: wharf frontage strip drawn with bay to page-left, land to page-right, terminated on its landward side by the heavy triple-rule panel border (centerline x=3789@y0 to x=3866@y7795). Contains Piers 17-22 with sheds, GWC terminal tracks & yard, block fronts, Ave A or Water. Pier 22 at panel bottom is duplicated on panel B.
properties.pier_range: 16/17-22 (Pier 16 not drawn; coverage begins at slip east of Pier 17; index assigns 16-28 to sheet 5)
properties.adjoining_sheet: 6 (top edge, east, at (1740,220)); 33 (landward at 17th, (2980,1420)); 7 (landward at 19th-20th, (3240,4270)); 9 (landward at 21st-22nd, (3290,6320))

properties.description: West panel: continuation of the same frontage, drawn as a second parallel strip to the right of the panel divider, same orientation (bay page-left). Begins with blank paper + bay water immediately right of the rule, then Piers 22-28, Mallory Steamship Co. shed (Piers 23-26), Sykes Bros shed (Pier 27), GWC terminal tracks & yard, Ave A or Water at far right margin. Pier 22 at panel top duplicates panel A's Pier 22.
properties.cross_street_range: 22nd St (y~230) to 28th St (y~7290) on right margin; 23rd/Tremont y~1400, 24th y~2530, 25th/Rosenberg y~3715, 26th y~5000, 27th y~6150
properties.adjoining_sheet: 9 (right margin boxed at 23rd/Tremont, (6460,1560)); 11 (right margin at ~25th, (6440,4390)); 13 (right margin at 27th-28th, (6460,6830) and bottom edge (5990,7540)); 4 (bottom edge, west, at (4830,7550))

properties.description: Drafted panel divider: heavy ~22 px solid rule flanked by thin parallel lines (triple-line border), running the full page height, measured centerline. It is panel A's landward border; blank paper then panel B's bay water lie to its right (gap narrows near bottom where Pier 28 of panel B approaches at x~3900). Not a physical page edge; not a shoreline feature.

Portion of panel A outside the mosaic target footprint (target = Piers 19-25 / 19th-25th St): Piers 17-18, their slips, and the 16th-18th St landward strip. Southern boundary approximate (drawn across the slip between Pier 18 and Pier 19; Pier 18 label y=2040, Pier 19 label y=3520, 19th St landward y~3730).

Portion of panel B outside the mosaic target footprint (target = Piers 19-25 / 19th-25th St): Piers 26-28, Sykes Bros shed, and the 26th-28th St landward strip. Northern boundary approximate (drawn between the full extent of Pier 25 and Pier 26; Pier 25 label y=3696, Pier 26 label y=5064, 26th St landward y~5000).
